control: Best single setting per graph, using validation batch-median totals only.
guard: Use the frozen target-dependent model in a graph only when its validation total is at least 2 percent lower and both validation repetition totals beat that graph fixed setting. Otherwise use the graph fixed setting.
comparison: Three rotated repetitions of graph_fixed, learned, guarded on every successfully reference-checked reserved case. Same native executable, targets, prescribed basis and resources.
frozen_weights: The original trained model remains unchanged. No test result is used to set the guard.
public_application: The current public interface uses the validated graph guard once available. Unknown graph structures retain native choices.
